desk.headline: Q3 profit up 13% to ₩1.91tn (reported 29 Oct); KB Securities hit with ₩332bn bond-auction fine; no guidance

other.label: Net profit attributable to shareholders, Q3
Net profit attributable to shareholders, 9 months

results: KB's Q3 results came out on 29 October; the 13 November filing is not a results release.
Preliminary Q3 net profit rose 13% to ₩1.91tn from ₩1.69tn; nine-month profit rose 13% to ₩5.79tn. Figures are still under audit review.
Press coverage said Q3 profit slipped from Q2's record as stock trading cooled and brokerage fees fell.
On 11 November the Korea Fair Trade Commission fined KB Securities ₩332.2bn over alleged collusion among primary dealers in government bond auctions.
KB Securities will review the formal decision when it arrives; the final amount may differ from the regulator's press release.

guidance.summary: KB gives no earnings guidance in these filings.

watch: The regulator's written decision and KB Securities' response, including any appeal.
Whether fee income recovers after the Q3 drop in stock trading.
Audited Q3 figures, as the reported numbers are preliminary.
